business.name: El Gran Sabor
business.tagline: Authentic Salvadoran & Mexican home cooking in Columbia, MD.
business.description: El Gran Sabor is a family-run Salvadoran and Mexican kitchen tucked into Oakland Mills. The hand-pressed pupusas — filled with chicharrón, cheese, or loroco — are made fresh to order. Fajitas arrive on a sizzling cast iron plate, the tacos come loaded and generously portioned, and the homemade chips and salsa are worth the trip alone. Everything tastes like it was cooked by someone who loves food. Because it was.
business.address: 5865 Robert Oliver Place, Unit D, Columbia, MD 21045
business.testimonial_quote: The pupusas are some of the best I've had — homemade, crispy on the outside and perfectly filled. The carne asada tacos are packed with flavor. This place is a hidden gem.
